input: A customer asks whether they can receive a refund after 10 days on the Starter plan.
expected: Answer the refund question using the 14-day window and mention email support.
reference_answer: Starter customers can request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Ask them to contact support@acme.test so the billing team can process it.

input: An enterprise prospect asks what response SLA they receive on the Enterprise tier.
expected: State the four-hour first-response SLA and dedicated Slack support.
reference_answer: Enterprise customers receive a four-hour first-response SLA and a dedicated Slack escalation channel for urgent incidents.

input: A workspace admin wants to add two more seats before renewal.
expected: Say seats can be added immediately and are prorated.
reference_answer: They can add seats immediately from billing settings and the extra seats will be prorated for the remainder of the billing period.

input: A security reviewer asks whether customer data is stored in the EU today.
expected: Say the default region is US and EU residency is on the roadmap.
reference_answer: Today the default hosting region is the US. EU data residency is on the roadmap but it is not generally available yet.
